title: Wayang kulit shadow-puppet theatre with gamelan
summary: Wayang kulit, shadow-puppet theatre performed on Java and Bali, is accompanied by a gamelan orchestra of metallophones, gongs and other instruments seated behind the puppeteer. Its exact origins are unknown; it is first mentioned in an Old Javanese poem from the early 11th century. UNESCO proclaimed Indonesia’s wayang puppet theatre a Masterpiece of Oral and Intangible Heritage in 2003.

uncertainty.note: Tradition with unknown origin; the earliest mention is in the Old Javanese poem Arjunawiwaha dating from the early 11th century (Museum Folkwang). The range marks first documentary mention, not a founding date.

when.display: Origin unknown; first mentioned early 11th century
